description: This source file defines the EventReminderWorker class, a background worker for an Android app that uses the WorkManager API to schedule notifications for calendar events. It sets up notification channels for Android O and above, retrieves today's events from the database, and posts notifications for each event.

classes.name: EventReminderWorker
classes.description: A Worker class that schedules notifications for calendar events occurring today.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs the work of fetching today's events from the database and creating notifications for each event.
